record.question: Which of the following is not amongst the circumstances for which permission to a Government servant seeking retirement under FR 56 (k)(1) may be withheld?
options: If the Government servant is under suspension
If the Government servant is an eminent scientist of international stature
If a charge-sheet has been issued and the disciplinary proceedings are pending.
If the judicial proceedings on charges which may amount to grave misconduct, are pending
record.explanation: Eminent scientist status is not a withholding circumstance for retirement.
